kish.observation: Institution confirms NJCAA athletics and baseball but does not establish the baseball division.

sullivan.observation: 2024 institutional statement identifies baseball as Division II; older than the 2026-27 directory DIII entry.

frontier.observation: 2025 institutional newsletter describes Frontier as Division I; current baseball division still requires independent resolution.

carteret.observation: October 16, 2025 announcement establishes planned NJCAA entry in 2026-27 with baseball and postseason eligibility in 2027-28. Does not establish baseball division.

nicc.observation: Institution confirms NJCAA and ICCAC acceptance, baseball among new sports, beginning August 2025. Current athletics site retrieval returned HTTP 403.

quincy.observation: Current athletics page identifies Steve Maze as NJCAA baseball head coach and Adams Field as baseball facility. Division and current roster still require review.

bsc.observation: Institution identifies Virginia, Ohio and Wisconsin campuses as NJCAA members, with baseball among sports across the system; says sports vary by location. Virginia-specific baseball division is not established.

swocc.observation: Official current baseball head-coach biography describes the program as competing in the NWAC. Appearance in all NJCAA baseball filters is not sufficient to add an NJCAA baseball program.

berkshire.observation: 2026 institutional update says baseball will not continue that year. Does not establish permanent closure or conclusively resolve spring 2027 status.

sandhills.observation: Reviewed institutional sports context did not independently establish current varsity baseball sponsorship. A baseball facility or summer team is not sufficient evidence.

robeson.observation: Institution currently links to athletics.robeson.edu, which the web tool could not retrieve. Saved NJCAA directory identifies Robeson under DII, but independent current baseball content remains to be captured.

monroe.observation: New Rochelle transition page explicitly says it is pursuing NCAA membership and is not currently an NCAA member. It gives anticipated provisional stages and CACC relationship. Do not promote automatically to active NCAA DII membership or confuse with Bronx.

lackawanna.observation: Institution explicitly identifies 2025-26 as its final NJCAA season and 2026-27 as start of PSAC competition while pursuing NCAA DII membership. This is a transition, not college or baseball closure.

swva.observation: October 30, 2025 institutional notice says all athletics will end after academic year 2025-26. Identifies college in Cedar Bluff, Virginia. College closure is not stated.

dallas.observation: Current institutional baseball fixture links distinguish Brookhaven, Cedar Valley, Eastfield, Mountain View, North Lake and Richland. Preserve separate programs; do not collapse them into one Dallas directory team ID.

mn.observation: Institution identifies NJCAA/MCAC DIII athletics and separately lists baseball at Hibbing, Itasca, Mesabi Range, Rainy River and Vermilion. Preserve separate campus programs despite directory omissions.

itasca.observation: Institution identifies Itasca campus in Grand Rapids within Minnesota North; stored California state requires correction review.

tonkawa.observation: Institution explicitly locates Tonkawa campus at 1220 E. Grand, Tonkawa, OK 74653. Do not merge Tonkawa with Enid.

tonkawaStaff.observation: 2026-27 institutional organizational chart lists distinct baseball coaches for Tonkawa and Enid, supporting separate campus programs.

luzerne.observation: Current institutional page publishes mens baseball and coach Ross Turetsky. Directory absence is not closure evidence; current-season membership still needs resolution.

ccCA.observation: Official athletics domain publishes a 2026-27 baseball roster and coaching staff. Current campus identity and membership need reconciliation; do not merge with Michigan or Georgia namesakes.

ccMI.observation: Institutional baseball page is California-focused and contains 2023 practice information. It does not resolve current Michigan campus baseball sponsorship or division.
